## The Python seat's own examples

Beside its twins the Python seat ships topical examples. Each is mapped to the C programs that cover the same ground.

| Python example | Status | C evidence | Boundary |
|---|---|---|---|
| `basics/first_steps.py` | native | [basics/first_steps.c](basics/first_steps.c) | The C example asserts the corresponding behavior through the public C surface. |
| `data/array_interop.py` | adapted | [data/array_marshalling.c](data/array_marshalling.c), [data/counted_text.c](data/counted_text.c), [integration/borrowed_storage.c](integration/borrowed_storage.c), [gallery/symbolic_tensors.c](gallery/symbolic_tensors.c) | Explicit buffers, child vectors and CBLAS replace Python array interchange protocols; no Arrow or NumPy adapter is claimed. |
